items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: and the drummer was Charlie Smith, marvelous drummer, and Kenny Durham.

ctx.x: He had his own group, and he worked with Earl Hines, worked with another band by -- I think it was Jesse Stone. And I went to Haiti with Bud Johnson, and -- around the middle forties, say between '46 and '48 I think around the time -- and stayed for six weeks. And in this

band was Billy Taylor, the bass player was Lloyd Trotman and the drummer was Charlie Smith, marvelous drummer, and Kenny Durham. They had a centennial this year and Marion Anderson was there also. It was a wonderful experience but at night it was a drag because -- we lived in a little town called Patientville. It's about 12 miles, almost straight up the --
